files.name: motion-prompt-001.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Pop-in" (ポップイン), one of the names in "Motion graphics moves".
Motion Prompt #001

What it is: Pops into view with a small bounce
What the sample shows: An app icon pops in with a bounce, then a notification badge pops in a moment later.
Spec:
- One pop per 2.35 s (twice per 4.7 s cycle: a star on coral first, then a heart on blue).
- Icon: 116 px rounded square (radius 30). From 0.28 s, scale 0→1 with a spring: 1 − e^(−6.5t)·cos(15t), peaking at about 1.26.
- At the same time, rotation −0.35 rad (about −20°) → 0 with a spring: 1 − e^(−6t)·cos(11t).
- Badge: yellow circle, radius 25, with "1", at the icon's top-right (+52, −52). Starts at 0.62 s with spring 1 − e^(−7t)·cos(17t).
- Exit: 1.86–2.12 s. Scale is multiplied by (1 − backIn, s = 2.2), so it swells slightly and then shrinks to 0.
- Floor shadow: 62 × 8 ellipse that scales with the icon (clamped to 0–1).
When to use it: Use it to bring in a small element such as an icon, button or badge with a light accent.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/001.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/motion.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
